examples.japanese: {単位|たんい}が{足|た}りなくて{留年|りゅうねん}した。
examples.english: I had to repeat a year because I didn't have enough credits.

examples.japanese: {留年|りゅうねん}しないように{頑張|がんば}っている。
examples.english: I am working hard so I don't have to repeat a year.

examples.japanese: {留年|りゅうねん}すると{学費|がくひ}が{増|ふ}える。
examples.english: If you repeat a year, tuition increases.

notes:
{留年|りゅうねん} means staying in the same grade for an additional year, typically due to poor grades or insufficient credits.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {留年|りゅうねん}する (to repeat a year)
- {留年|りゅうねん}が{決|き}まる (to have it decided that one repeats)
- {留年|りゅうねん}を{回避|かいひ}する (to avoid repeating a year)
- {留年|りゅうねん}{生|せい} (student who is repeating)

CAUSES:
- {単位|たんい}{不足|ふそく} (insufficient credits)
- {出席|しゅっせき}{日数|にっすう}{不足|ふそく} (insufficient attendance)
- {成績|せいせき}{不良|ふりょう} (poor grades)

ALTERNATIVE TERM:
- {落第|らくだい} - similar meaning but sounds more negative

CONTRAST:
- {浪人|ろうにん}: Gap year before entering university (to retake entrance exams)
- {留年|りゅうねん}: Repeating a year while enrolled

definitions.gloss: repeating a year (in school), being held back a grade
